newSqlNeeded.reason: cad_property is currently never selected with property_number or quick_ref_id in this file (CAD_ROWS_SQL omits both), and txgio_parcel.geo_id is never read at all here (landing_parcel_jurisdiction does not carry it -- confirmed via its own INSERT column list in p2-juris-store.mjs: county_fips, prop_id, disposition, method, place_fips, city_name, run_id, chunk_lo, chunk_hi -- no geo_id).
newSqlNeeded.nodeGeoIdSql: NODE_GEO_ID_SQL = `SELECT prop_id::text AS prop_id, geo_id FROM txgio_parcel WHERE county_fips = $1 AND prop_id = ANY($2) AND geo_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(geo_id) <> ''` -- read from the same `cortex` connection already used for CAD_ROWS_SQL/LANDING_ROWS_SQL (txgio_parcel and cad_property are confirmed to live in the same source store).
newSqlNeeded.accountCrosswalkSql: Mirror CADROLL_EXPECTATION_SQL_GATE_BLOCKED's proven ambiguity guard, but SELECT the full CAD row content (not just existence), keyed back to the node's own prop_id: `SELECT DISTINCT ON (tp.prop_id) tp.prop_id AS node_prop_id, cp.prop_id AS account_prop_id, cp.quick_ref_id, cp.tax_year, cp.situs_address, cp.situs_city, cp.situs_zip, cp.legal_description, cp.exemption_codes, cp.land_value, cp.improvement_value, cp.market_value, cp.assessed_value, cp.year_built, cp.living_area_sqft, cp.land_acres, cp.property_use_code FROM txgio_parcel tp JOIN cad_property cp ON cp.county_fips = tp.county_fips AND btrim(cp.property_number) = btrim(tp.geo_id) WHERE tp.county_fips = $1 AND tp.prop_id = ANY($2) AND tp.geo_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(tp.geo_id) <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cad_property cp2 WHERE cp2.county_fips = cp.county_fips AND btrim(cp2.property_number) = btrim(cp.property_number) AND cp2.prop_id <> cp.prop_id) ORDER BY tp.prop_id, cp.tax_year DESC`

crosswalkDesign.appLevelCorroboration: After the SQL returns candidate rows, apply the SAME corroboration accountCrosswalkForNode does (do not skip it the way PR #144's sampling smoke-test deliberately did -- #144 is a read-only check tolerant of widening; this is the writer, and a wrong bind here becomes served customer data): stem = quick_ref_id R-stem (digits after a leading R/r, case-insensitive; null if not R-prefixed). Accept the bind when stem is null (silent/no corroborator, same as accountCrosswalkForNode's 'accountStemFeature == null -> true') OR stem === node's own prop_id. Refuse (reason corroboration-refused) when stem is non-null and disagrees. A node with no candidate row at all (no geo_id, or geo_id names no account, or ambiguous and dropped by the SQL's NOT EXISTS guard) gets reason no-crosswalk-account.
crosswalkDesign.integrationIntoLoadLandingAndCad: For county in SEED_BLOCKED_FIPS: run NODE_GEO_ID_SQL and the account-crosswalk SQL (both scoped to this page's propIds, no new full-table scan); build effectiveCadByProp keyed by NODE prop_id (never the crosswalked account's own prop_id, so every existing cadByProp.get(propId) call site elsewhere in the file keeps working unmodified) pointing at the crosswalk-resolved CAD row, or absent (map has no entry) when reason is no-crosswalk-account/corroboration-refused -- honest absence, never a fallback to the bare-prop_id row. For a county NOT in SEED_BLOCKED_FIPS: identical object reference to the existing cadByProp construction, zero behaviour change (byte-identical output), matching the mission's falsifier #2. Compose AFTER the existing Williamson same-roll R-prefix/numeric merge (loadWilliamsonCrosswalk/mergeWilliamsonCrosswalk stays exactly where it is), not instead of it -- see williamsonCaveat for why both must coexist.
